candidate.content: In ALFWorld kitchen environments, lettuce targets are frequently located on open surfaces (countertops) rather than in closed storage units. A search strategy that prioritizes inspecting visible open receptacles (e.g., countertop_1, countertop_2) before navigating to or opening closed containers (e.g., fridge, cabinets) can rapidly locate and acquire the target object.
candidate.scope: Applies to initial target acquisition phases for 'lettuce' in kitchen tasks where multiple receptacle types are visible and the specific location is unknown. Does not cover subsequent cooling or placement steps.

direct_grounding.semantic_fact: The agent navigated to an open surface (countertop_1) as part of the search sequence.

Upon navigating to a second open surface (countertop_2), the agent observed two instances of the target object (lettuce_1, lettuce_2) present on the surface without needing to perform an 'open' action.
The agent successfully acquired the target object (lettuce_1) directly from the open surface (countertop_2).

minimal_global_context: The trajectory demonstrates that the target was found on the second inspected open surface, confirming that lettuce can be stored on countertops in this environment type.
